Weak Signal Propagation Reporter，用极低功率（m: Weak Signal Propagation Reporter: a weak-signal mode that probes propagation at milliwatt levels.
与 FT8 同样需要严格时间同步。: Like FT8, it requires strict time synchronisation.
全球接收站汇总数据，可查看各波段实时传播图。: Receiving stations worldwide aggregate the data, giving live propagation maps per band.
发射功率可低至 mW 级（WSPR 编码下限 0 dBm = 1mW），传播良好: Transmit power as low as the milliwatt range (0 dBm = 1 mW, the WSPR encoding floor) is often enough for worldwide reception when propagation is good.
发射后到 wsprnet.org 查看自己的信号被哪些台站接收。: After transmitting, check wsprnet.org to see which stations received your signal.
周期发送呼号、网格、功率等信息，接收站解码并上传到 WSPRnet 数据库。: Periodically transmits callsign, grid and power; receiving stations decode it and upload to the WSPRnet database.
遵守功率限制，WSPR 是信标模式，不应占用话音通联频率。: Observe the power limit: WSPR is a beacon mode and should not occupy voice operating frequencies.
